in_arabic.name: فايزال
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الفوز يدل على النجاح والفلاح

in_english.name: Fayzal
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fayzal originates from the Arabic root f-w-z, signifying success, victory, and triumph. Referenced in the Quran (Surah Al-Imran: 'And those who believe and do righteous deeds are the successful ones'), it symbolizes achieving divine pleasure and Jannah. Historically significant in Islamic tradition, it represents desirable personality traits such as determination and resilience.
